title: Autonomous Action Contract
description: A spoken request, crystallised into a checkable form. The vocabulary contains no estate name -- no zone, no registry, no provider (the same rule schema/intent/*.schema.json follows).

feature.description: The outcome, named. A person should be able to read this alone and know what was asked for.

given.description: The precondition that must hold before the scenario begins.

then.description: The checkable outcome. If a person cannot say yes or no to this, it is not a then.

agents_required.description: Parallel workers this work needs. Capped at 5 because the estate runs on the OKE always-free tier: 4 Ampere A1 instances, 24GB total.
